name: 索恩薇娅
who: A woman who looks about 27, an empress who rose from the reed-hut slums and still carries herself like a soldier, 174 cm, tall and lean with the settled stance of someone who has marched and ridden all her life. Dark old-copper gold-brown hair, pulled back into a braided bun at the back with one long thin strand left falling at the side, the front bangs burnt paler toward platinum at the tips; pale gold eyes, cool and clear like a freshly wiped sword blade; a thin old scar near one cheekbone. Her face is hard-lined and beautiful without any soft courtly air.
palette: clean white and warm brass-gold, old-copper brown shadows, one small dawn-orange accent
casual: Her imperial field uniform in white: a fitted white officer's coat with a high stand collar closed to the throat, thin gold edging and small star-shaped gold buttons, a short white cloak hanging from both shoulders with gold-braided shoulder cords and a gold tassel, a black high-collared undershirt, a plain gold-plated pauldron on one shoulder, white trousers tucked into dark riding boots, a slim brown belt. A small gold circlet of tiny spikes pinned at the top of the bun. One gloved hand rests on her belt, a calm, cold, watchful expression.
private: Back in her rooms after a long council: a plain high-necked cream linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow and buttoned, a long dark brown wool vest, dark trousers, soft house boots. The braided bun is loosened and the long side strand lies over her shoulder. She holds a worn field map folded small. A tired, quiet, faintly human look.

Both hands hold a long plain straight sword point-down in front of her, its hilt wrapped with hemp cord, a bandaged burn scar on the back of one hand. A grounded, unmoving stance, a hard level gaze.
formal: Her coronation dress uniform: a long white tailored coat with a high collar and gold embroidery along the edges, a white-and-gold cape pinned at both shoulders and flowing back, white gloves, a gold sash, polished white boots, a slim gold crown of small spikes on the braided hair. She stands straight, one hand at the hilt of a plain ceremonial sword, a composed, absolutely steady expression.
art: A tight bust shot, the head level, her pale gold eyes looking straight at the viewer with a cool, unflinching, slightly weary expression; one gloved hand lifts the high white collar a little, the other hand just visible holding a plain sword with a hemp-wrapped hilt. Hard-edged shadow from the cloak's edge falls across half her face, warm dawn light on the other half. Foreground blur: drifting threads of gold and bits of torn banner cloth. She wears the white officer's coat with the high collar and gold stars.

One hand rests at the bronze belt, a cold, composed, unreadable expression.

battle: Field dress for a campaign: a fitted black coat-dress with high collar and long sleeves, bronze-plated shoulder guards and a bronze belt, black leather vambraces, the ember-crimson half-cape pinned to one shoulder, a black leather glove and a bare hand, dark leggings under a long split skirt, bronze-buckled boots. formal: Imperial court dress: a floor-length black gown with a high collar and long sleeves, a narrow band of bronze embroidery down the front and along the cuffs, a long ember-crimson cape fastened with a bronze clasp, a slim bronze circlet over the silver hair, one long black glove. One black-gloved hand holds a single chess-like bronze piece near her collar. Hard-edged shadow of a tall window mullion falls across her eyes, cold silver light on the hair. Foreground blur: falling ash flakes and drifting ember sparks. She wears the black high-collared dress with the ember-crimson half-cape.

name: 瓦尔德拉克
who: An adult demon-kin man who looks about 35, a general of the black legion, tall with a broad chest and shoulders and a soldier's heavy build. palette: midnight black and ink-blue, antique gold, one small violet-gem accent

One gloved hand holds a closed leather law book against her hip, a flat, composed expression.
private: At her desk in her chambers late: a plain dark grey high-necked blouse with long sleeves, a long charcoal skirt, soft flat shoes, the hair loosely tied low with a black ribbon, sleeves pushed up. She holds a pen and a half-marked page. A tired, severe, softening look.
battle: Field dress for a tribunal on the road: a fitted black long coat with a high collar and gold stitching, a light black leather harness over it with a short dark-gold pauldron on one shoulder, dark leggings and boots, black gloves, a short black mantle. She holds a slender black rod of office tipped with a small golden scale in one hand, the other hand open at her side. An upright, still stance, a precise, cold gaze.
formal: High court robes: a floor-length black robe with a high collar and gold embroidered panels, a wide black-and-gold stole, long black gloves, gold and violet-gem earrings, hair in a neat high style with a thin gold pin. She stands very straight, one hand on a gold-clasped law book, a stern, still expression.
art: A tight bust shot in profile turning toward the viewer, the grey-blue eyes cutting sideways with a cool, exact, expressionless stare; one black-gloved finger rests on the edge of an open law book at her chest. Hard-edged shadow of a courtroom grille falls across her eyes, cold blue light on the hair. Foreground blur: falling black wax flakes and scraps of parchment. She wears the black judge's robe with the high collar and the gold edging.

name: 亚历山大
who: An adult man who looks about 36, the governor of a great fleet, tall and broad-shouldered, 188 cm, with rough hands that know the helm. Deep sea-blue hair cut neat like a fleet's signal line but with some wet strands falling at the brow, steel blue-grey eyes with a heavy, storm-quelling gaze; a calm, weathered face.
palette: deep navy and sea blue, steel silver, one small brass-gold accent
casual: His admiral's uniform: a long deep-navy coat with a high stiff collar, silver epaulettes with short fringes, a narrow blue-and-white ribbon badge on the chest, thin silver chains looped across the shoulders, a white shirt under it, dark trousers and tall black boots, a long navy cloak like a rolled night wave on his shoulders. One hand rests on the hilt of a slim sword at his hip, a steady, silent, sober expression.
private: On the quay at dawn with the fleet asleep: a thick navy fisherman's jumper with a high rolled neck, rolled sleeves, dark trousers, plain boots, hair damp with spray. He holds a coil of rope over one arm and a small brass compass in the other palm. A calm, tired, almost fond look.
battle: Naval war gear: a dark navy long coat with a high collar over a steel breastplate with a small anchor-and-wheel crest, silver pauldrons, leather gloves, a short navy cloak flowing back, sea-wet black boots. Both hands hold the shaft of a tall silver-bladed trident-halberd upright in front of him, planted on the deck. A wide, braced sailor's stance, a heavy, unhurried gaze.
formal: Fleet dress uniform: a long navy frock coat with rows of silver buttons, a broad blue sash with a silver star order, white gloves, a short navy cape trimmed with silver, polished boots, a dress sword at the hip. He stands upright with the chin level, a grave, calm expression.
art: A tight bust shot from slightly below, the head turned in three-quarter profile, the steel-blue eyes looking at the viewer with a steady, storm-calm, reserved expression; the long silver trident-halberd head rises behind his shoulder. Cold blue light from a stormy sky, hard-edged shadow of the collar falls across his jaw. Foreground blur: flying sea spray and loose rope ends. He wears the long deep-navy coat with the high stiff collar and silver epaulettes.

name: 基修亚
who: An older man who looks about 60, the head of an arcane research council, tall and lean, with an old scholar's lordly bearing. Short swept-up white hair, a neat short white beard, red eyes lined with the creases of a long, knowing smile; warm tan skin. His smile is gentle, and hard to tell whether it is fondness, teasing, or something he saw long ago.
palette: deep black and old gold, sapphire blue, one small rose-pink accent
casual: His grand scholar's robe: a long black coat-robe with a high collar and wide gold-embroidered edges, a row of large sapphire-blue buttons down the front, a thin gold chain with a small star medal, rose-pink tassels hanging from the collar, a black high-collared shirt under it, dark gloves. A tall black walking cane with a silver curved handle set with a blue gem in one hand and a thick book bound in black metal under the other arm. A mild, amused, patient smile.
private: In his observatory study late at night: a soft dark blue wool dressing-robe with a shawl collar over a plain white high-collared shirt, loose dark trousers, soft slippers, the cane left leaning against the desk. He holds a small tin cup of tea and a half-finished star chart. A quiet, fond, faintly mischievous smile.
battle: Field dress for a collapsing sky: a black long coat with a high collar and gold stitching, a lighter sapphire-blue breast guard with thin brass gear-like rings, black leather gloves, short dark pauldrons, tall boots, a short black cape. His cane in his right hand with its blue gem glowing and a slim ring of gold light turning around it above his open left palm. A relaxed but planted stance, a sharp, calm gaze.
formal: Council chair's dress: a long black and gold ceremonial robe with a high collar, a broad dark-blue sash with a gold star order, a row of sapphire buttons, a short gold-edged black cape, white gloves, a small black cap-like hat with a gold star. He stands with both hands on the cane, an easy, dignified expression.
art: A tight bust shot from slightly below, the head tilted and the red eyes looking at the viewer with a warm, lightly teasing, slightly sad smile; one gloved hand rests on the silver curved cane handle with the blue gem near his chin. Warm golden light from an armillary sphere behind him, hard-edged shadow of its rings falls across half his face. Foreground blur: drifting gold dust and small star charts. He wears the black gold-edged robe with the sapphire buttons.
